text:
nina (product): quick decision needed for the Optimize toolkit pilot: ACME wants an 'eval sentinel' for quantized routes plus per-route batching/caching recommendations. can we lock scope for a 3-week pilot?

raj (eng-runtime): can do a narrow MVP. suggest we split into: 1) eval-sentinels (alerting + golden-set configs), 2) batch/cache advisor (telemetry-driven recs), 3) non-automatic quant advice (read-only). auto-change = future.

toni (research): for eval-sentinels we need to define detection algorithms. proposing 3 modes: "delta-match" (token-match drop pct), "nli-consistency" (semantic shift), and "embed-distance" (drift). start with delta-match for pilot.

alex (sre): important: alerting -> severity tiers, confirmation run, and paging policy. we should not page ops for every 2% blip. recommend thresholds: warn @3% (dashboard), page @6% with 2nd confirm run.

ben (solutions): ACME's ask: per-prompt granularity (they want to see which prompts fail). we should include top-N failing prompts in the alert.

nina (product): acceptance criteria for pilot (proposal):
- UI: golden-set upload + map to routes
- Alerts: webhook + console card + top-10 failing prompts
- Advisor: per-route batch-size + cache-TTL recommendations surfaced in a console card
- Docs: runbook + starter golden templates (chat + single-turn)
- Pilot test: run with ACME 25-prompt set and simulate a 6% delta-match regression
aj (eng-runtime): implementation notes: quick sentinel uses sampled evals every 2m (cheap, 50 prompt sample) -> if breach, spin full eval job (configurable per-customer). sampled evals feed metrics to metrics pipeline; need a new metric: customer.golden.delta_pct.

toni (research): sample size sensitivity: 50 prompts gives noisy signal for small deltas. we can use stratified sampling: prioritize recent prompts and those with prior failure risk. I'll share sampling heuristic doc.

alex (sre): infra constraints: eval jobs are CPU-heavy; add soft quotas per-org and fail-open to avoid throttling production. suggest default = 8 eval-minutes/hr.

ben (solutions): UI placement: propose an "Optimize Advisor" card on the route details page that houses recs + a toggle to enable sentinel alerts. less friction than new top-level page.

nina (product): rollout policy: hosted customers see read-only recs; Dedicated/private can opt into auto-fallback later. legal and security must sign-off before any auto-routing.

raj (eng-runtime): for batching/caching recs: algorithm = compute latency distribution per-route over 24h window, simulate batch sizes (2..16) with expected p50/p95 impact and cost delta, pick largest batch that keeps p95 < route SLO. cache-TTL suggestion = compute repeat-request ratio and freshness tolerance.

toni (research): we'll provide delta estimates for quantization modes: q4_0, q4_k_m, q8_0 - include expected accuracy delta and token throughput uplift. tag recs with confidence bands.

nina (product): launch checklist items: product PRD, engineering tickets + owners, starter golden-set templates, runbook with confirm-run steps, console card mockups, SRE paging rules, quota defaults, outreach plan to ACME.

deploy-bot: new deploy queued: optimize-toolkit/sentinel-sampler -> staging (PR #4266)

alex (sre): monitoring: add metric alert burn-rate check to avoid noisy alerts spamming Slack. use 5m confirmation window before paging.

ben (solutions): acceptance test for go/no-go: inject synthetic failures into canary model to create a 6% drop across the golden set and verify alert path (console -> webhook -> recommended action).

raj (eng-runtime): timeline: week 1 = sentinel backend + golden-set API + sample runner; week 2 = console card + advisor recs + webhook; week 3 = docs + canary with ACME. auto-fallback backlog item scheduled week 6.

nina (product): risks: 1) false positives -> ops fatigue, 2) eval cost -> surprise billing, 3) misinterpreted recommendations -> cust confusion. mitigations: confirmation run, quotas, clear microcopy that recs are heuristics.

toni (research): one more: metric drift vs real regressions. include a synthetic control prompt set to detect tooling regressions.

ben (solutions): I'll draft the golden-set templates: 10 chat sessions, 20 single-turns recommended for pilot. include hallucination markers.

alex (sre): I'll add paging policy + escalation matrix to the runbook.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll open tickets and ping eng-platform for per-route token metric export.

nina (product): OK let's commit to the above scope. @ben please prep ACME onboarding email, @raj create the tickets, @toni share sampling heuristics. we'll reconvene EOD Friday to confirm sprint board.

ben (solutions): ACME is ok with pilot constraints as long as recs show confidence bands.

nina (product): great. closing thread unless blockers.

alex (sre): one blocker: do we have permission to run customer prompt evals in prod infra? need legal sign-off on storing customer prompts for evaluation.

nina (product): good catch. @legal needed. adding item to checklist.

ben (solutions): noted.

nina (product): thanks everyone.
